product.title: Bar Harbor Premium Tour with Cadillac Mountain and Acadia Park

description.text: Discover Bar Harbor and Acadia National Park on a small-group half-day tour with hotel pickup and a lobster roll finish. Stops commonly include Sieur de Monts Spring, Thunder Hole, Otter Cliff, and Cadillac Mountain with live local commentary. Stops include Sieur de Monts Spring, Thunder Hole, Otter Cliff, Cadillac Mountain, Bar Harbor Lobster Pound. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on coastal overlooks, carriage roads, and photography or adventure highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Bar Harbor who want a guided Acadia National Park experience without coordinating park logistics, trailheads, or carriage roads on their own.
